title: Global Controller
description:
About Customer.io

Founded in 2012 and named to the 2025 Inc. 5000 list of fastest-growing private companies, Customer.io is a global, remote-first company of about 180 people across 36 countries. Over 9,000 companies, from startups to global brands, use our platform to send billions of emails, push notifications, in-app messages, and SMS every day. We help teams send smarter, more relevant messages using real-time behavioral data.

About the role

Hi, my name is Diep N, VP, Finance at Customer.io , and I'm looking for a Global Controller to take the close, the books, and our control environment and make them theirs.

We're a global, remote-first, private company built on subscription and usage-based revenue, and as we grow we need a controller who can lead the team already in place and sharpen the fundamentals. You'll lead a team of ~7, growing, across revenue accounting, close, AP/AR, payroll, and treasury, and partner closely with me and, given our CFO's broad remit, with stakeholders across Sales, Legal, IT, HR, and Engineering.

What you'll do

• Lead monthly and quarterly close, GL, AP/AR, payroll, and account reconciliations, delivering accurate, timely US GAAP financials. Close currently runs ~10 business days; get us to 6-8 days within your first 12 months, with fewer post-close adjustments and aged reconciliations.

• Own revenue accounting and serve as our technical accounting authority on subscription and usage-based revenue recognition (ASC 606), including the ARR-to-GAAP bridge: reconciling ARR, billings, deferred revenue, contract assets, and usage true-ups to reported revenue, and explaining the delta to leadership and the board in plain terms.

• Author technical accounting position memos on contract modifications, SSP allocation, variable consideration, and capitalized contract costs, the work that makes "technical accounting authority" real.

• Own equity compensation accounting (ASC 718): grant accuracy, 409A timing, expense, modifications, and cap-table integrity, in partnership with stock plan administration.

• Manage and grow a team of ~7, with room to scale, building trust quickly and developing the leads beneath you.

• Build a control framework suited to a global, remote-first, private company with subscription and usage-based revenue, keeping the books audit-ready.

• Own our accounting systems roadmap (NetSuite, Stripe/Metronome, Ramp, Avalara, FloQast) and drive automation across close and reporting.

• Own select treasury operations, including cash management and banking relationships, and partner on FX exposure monitoring given our multi-currency footprint.

• Run our external audit relationship and coordinate with external tax partners on compliance, provisions, and filings.

• Manage the realities of a distributed, remote-first global team: statutory accounting coordination, payroll and contractor controls, entity reporting, and working with Legal, HR, and Tax on international compliance.

What we're looking for

• 10+ years of progressive accounting experience, including leading a team through managers or leads.

• A Big 4 (or equivalent top-tier public accounting) foundation.

• Deep US GAAP mastery, particular strength in subscription and usage-based revenue recognition (ASC 606).

• A concrete, personally-owned automation or AI deployment in accounting with a measurable result, eliminating a manual reconciliation, reducing close time, or lowering error rate, that you can speak to in detail.

• Experience scaling an accounting function that was already running, not building one from zero.

• A proven track record with external audits and keeping books audit-ready.

• Strong leadership and communication skills, with credibility partnering with senior, cross-functional stakeholders.

• Nice to have: internal controls or SOX-readiness experience; remote-first/globally distributed company experience; M&A or deal accounting exposure; CPA license, active or inactive.

title: Staff Software Engineer, Autonomy Evaluation
description:
Job Description

General Motors is a global leader in advanced driverassistance. With Super Cruise hands-free technology in more than 500,000 Super Cruise-equipped vehicles on the road, and over 700 millionhands‑freemiles driven, GM is proving that automation can be trusted, intuitive, and helpful. GM has the global reach to bringcutting‑edgeadvances to everyday drivers at unprecedented scale. Join us to help deliver the next generation of safe and delightful personal autonomous vehicle experiences.

About the Organization

The Evaluation team builds and evolves the evaluation ecosystem that powers developing and scaling GM’s autonomous driving technology. We develop metrics, automated workflows, and analysis approaches that enable data-driven decisions across AV development and verification. Partnering with Autonomy, Simulation, Systems, and Safety teams, we act as system-level integrators and arbiters of end-to-end AV quality. We own large scale test scenario libraries, continuous evaluation pipelines, and critical risk assessment and release gating components, treating road testing, data mining, training, and metrics as first-class use cases in a unified analytics framework. By joining this team, you will help shape GM’s core evaluation platforms, turn system-level results into clear feedback, and help accelerate validated AV deployment at scale.

WhatYou’llDo

• Define the strategy and architecture for metrics and analyses to evaluate autonomous driving software performance across the autonomy stack.

• Lead cross-functional efforts with autonomy, systems engineering, simulation, and data teams to embed evaluation into development workflows and release decisions.

• Invent and drive new statistical and ML methods, and ML introspection techniques, to quantify performance, detect regressions, and reveal patterns of system behavior at scale.

• Own and refine key AV evaluation metrics and KPIs used for readiness and safety decisions; synthesize and present results and tradeoffs to stakeholders; make insights readily available to partner teams through interactive dashboards.

Your Skills and Abilities (Required Qualifications)

• 7+yearsapplied experience with robotics or autonomous systems software, spanning multiple subsystems fromperceptionthrough planning and control of the vehicle.

• 3+ years leading evaluation of complex dynamic systems using numerical and ML approaches on large-scale time series data.

• Proficiencydeveloping Python in production team environments; strong ability to work in large C++ autonomy codebases.

• Proven cross-team technical leadership, including defining strategies adopted by multiple teams and influencing system and architecture decisions.

• PhD, Masters, orBachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Robotics, Mechanical or Aerospace Engineering, Machine Learning, ora relatedfield.

What Will Give You a Competitive Edge (Preferred Qualifications)

• Experience in autonomous driving or high-stakes field robotics; designing, running, and interpreting large-scale simulation and field experiments.

• Deep familiarity with statistical modeling, experimental design, and hypothesis testing for autonomy evaluation; command of Pandas, NumPy, SciPy, and visualization libraries.

• Proficiencyin C++ and SQL, and experience shaping logging, data schemas, and evaluation pipelines for large-scale autonomy testing.

• Experience working with ROS or other IPC, robotics stack logging, and with large-scale experiment databases, including designing or scaling evaluation platforms.

• Priordevelopment with computational geometry, linear algebra,PyTorch, and machine learning.

• Background in modeling agent interaction and owning or designing release gating criteria and processes for autonomy systems.

About GM
Our vision is a world with Zero Crashes, Zero Emissions and Zero Congestion and we embrace the responsibility to lead the change that will make our world better, safer and more equitable for all.
Why Join Us

title: Manager, Pricing & Operations Strategy
description:
About Us

Our leading SaaS-based Global Employment Platform™ enables clients to expand into over 180 countries quickly and efficiently, without the complexities of establishing local entities. At G-P, we’re dedicated to breaking down barriers to global business and creating opportunities for everyone, everywhere.

Our diverse, remote-first teams are essential to our success. We empower our Dream Team members with flexibility and resources, fostering an environment where innovation thrives and every contribution is valued and celebrated.

The work you do here will positively impact lives around the world. We stand by our promise: Opportunity Made Possible. In addition to competitive compensation and benefits, we invite you to join us in expanding your skills and helping to reshape the future of work.

At G-P, we assist organizations in building exceptional global teams in days, not months-streamlining the hiring, onboarding, and management process to unlock growth potential for all.

About the role:

Driven by growth and ambitious targets, the Pricing & Operations Strategy team is seeking a Manager focused on tactical execution, business partnering support, and financial modeling. This role will support with protecting gross margins, accelerate sales cycles, and deliver analytical support across the organization to unlock high-impact revenue and margin initiatives.

What you’ll do:

• Cost-to-Serve Modeling : Own, update, and refine cost-to-serve models to ensure pricing accuracy and unit-economic margin protection.

• Cross-Functional Enablement : Support cross-functional teams on deal desk inquiries, retention strategies, capacity insights, and other initiatives.

• Financial Operations : Manage monthly and quarterly close activities and regular cadence deliverables.

• Business Unit Growth : Provide support to scale Gia and Contractor lines of business.

• Ad-Hoc Execution : Deliver high-quality analytical support as needed.

This high-impact, highly visible role offers exposure to leadership across the entire organization. If you thrive in a fast-paced environment with the ability to make an impact, this is the role for you.

What we’re looking for:

Minimum requirements:

• Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Business, or related field required.

• 5+ years of relevant experience (FP&A, Financial Analysis, Corporate Finance, or similar).

• Strong understanding of financial statements, P&L mechanics, and forecasting processes.

• Experience with financial modeling, budgeting, forecasting, and performance reporting.

• Advanced Excel and financial modeling skills; experience working with large datasets.

• Ability to synthesize complex data into clear, actionable insights for business leaders.

• Strong problem-solving skills with attention to detail and ability to connect drivers to outcomes.

• Experience supporting cross-functional stakeholders in a fast-paced, dynamic environment.

• Experience with SQL, PowerPivot, PowerQuery or other data querying tools preferred.

• Experience working in a fast paced, high growth environment

Preferred requirements:

• Relevant financial experience, particularly in cost-to-serve, revenue, and activations.

• Strong cross-functional experiences across multiple stakeholders and leadership levels

• Advanced Excel skills with experience using PowerPivot, PowerQuery, and shortcuts

We will consider for employment all qualified applicants who meet the inherent requirements for the position. Please note that background checks are required, and this may include criminal record checks.

The annual gross base salary range for this position is $110,400.00 - $138,000 plus variable compensation.

We will consider for employment all qualified applicants, including those with arrest records, conviction records, or other criminal histories, in a manner consistent with the requirements of any applicable state and local laws, including the City of Los Angeles’ Fair Chance Initiative

title: Podcast Studio Producer
description:
Role: Podcast Studio Producer
Contract Type: Full-time, 12 month rolling contract
Location: Remote, but ideally in Washington, DC
Salary: $80,000 - $90,000 (dependent on experience), + Benefits Package including 401k and Flex 125 plans
Interview Process: 3-stage (Virtual and Face-to-face)
Kinly is a leading integrator of audio-visual and unified communications solutions, and the largest in Europe, serving as a globally trusted technology advisor to leading organisations. For more than 25 years, we have been designing, developing, integrating and supporting complex audiovisual solutions and businesses rely on us to deliver consistently secure and flexible meeting experiences.
Exciting new opportunity has arisen on a fantastic client site for an experienced Podcast Studio Producer to be responsible for the end-to-end technical and creative management of live and recorded podcast productions.
This is a hands-on, fast-paced role demanding precision, professionalism, and the ability to operate complex broadcast technology while simultaneously ensuring an outstanding experience for on-air guests, including senior executives and high-profile VIPs.
The ideal candidate will combine deep technical broadcast expertise with exceptional interpersonal skills, thriving under pressure in a live studio environment.
Key responsibilities:

• Operate and manage the vMix live production system for multi-camera podcast recordings and live streams

• Configure and maintain vMix templates, scenes, transitions, and overlays tailored to each show

• Monitor stream health across all platforms (YouTube Live, LinkedIn, etc.) and troubleshoot in real time

• Manage stream keys, encoders, and ingest settings to ensure broadcast-quality output

• Set up and maintain NDI feeds, virtual sets, and lower-thirds graphics within the vMix environment

• Conduct pre-show technical checks and post-show recording archival and file management

• Operate the studio mixing console (digital/analog) during live recordings and live streams including Dante protocol

• Set levels, apply EQ, compression, gating, and reverb to achieve professional broadcast-standard audio

• Manage multiple microphone inputs (lavalier, condenser, dynamic) and ensure clean, clear audio for all guests

• Monitor and troubleshoot audio in real time, resolving feedback, interference, or signal issues during broadcasts

• Coordinate with post-production for audio clean-up, mixing, and mastering of final episode deliverables

• Maintain and calibrate all audio equipment including microphones, headphones, DI boxes, and patch bays

• Operate and switch between multiple studio cameras (PTZ and manned) during live recordings

• Direct camera movements, framing, and shot selection to complement the flow of each episode

• Configure camera settings (white balance, exposure, colour profiles) for consistent studio aesthetics

• Manage recording media and ensure all footage is properly labelled, backed up, and delivered

• Serve as the primary on-site point of contact for high-profile guests, senior executives, and VIP interviewees

• Brief guests on studio protocols, microphone technique, and on-camera best practices before recording

• Develop and maintain production runsheets, technical riders, and show templates

• Collaborate with producers, hosts, editors, and marketing teams to ensure seamless episode delivery

Skills and experience:

• Calm under pressure - able to manage live technical issues without disrupting the on-air talent

• Exceptional interpersonal skills - warm, professional, and confident when engaging with high-profile guests

• Highly organised with strong attention to detail in both technical setup and scheduling

• Self-motivated and proactive - takes ownership of the studio environment and continuously improves processes

• Proven experience operating vMix in a live broadcast or studio production environment

• Hands-on audio engineering experience with both analogue and digital mixin

title: Revenue Operations Manager - Common Room
description:
What You Can Expect

In this role, you will be the operational backbone of Zoom's go-to-market engine, owning the systems, data, processes, and reporting that keep our revenue teams running with clarity and speed. You will partner closely with sales, SDR, AM, and CS leadership to set quarterly priorities and translate cross-functional decisions into airtight rules of engagement. Day to day, you will run pipeline and forecast cadences, maintain the integrity of our GTM data model, and build the signal-driven programs that turn product and customer insights into pipeline. You will report to the Head of Revenue Operations and have real scope to grow the function over time.

About the Team

The Revenue Operations team at Zoom sits at the intersection of data, systems, and go-to-market strategy, giving our CRO and revenue leaders the operational clarity they need to grow with confidence. We partner across sales, marketing, and customer success to build the processes, tooling, and reporting that keep every handoff clean and every pipeline review grounded in fact. We are a small, hands-on team with a broad mandate and a real appetite for building things that scale.

Responsibilities

• Own the GTM tech stack end to end, including Salesforce configuration, automation, integrations, license management, and vendor evaluations.

• Build and maintain the GTM data model across CRM, marketing automation, sales engagement, billing, and product analytics, keeping it clean enough to power account-based and signal-based programs.

• Run weekly pipeline reviews and monthly and quarterly forecast readouts covering new business and expansion, and produce executive-level reporting for the CRO and Head of Revenue Operations.

• Design and enforce rules of engagement for inbound and outbound ownership, prospecting into large account hierarchies, and cross-team handoffs between SDRs, AEs, AMs, and CSMs.

• Build lead routing, territory logic, and account hierarchy frameworks with a focus on speed to lead.

• Partner with AM and CS teams to design signal-driven expansion programs powered by product and customer data, then automate them once proven.

• Collaborate with sales, SDR, AM, and CS leadership to set quarterly priorities and drive the cross-functional projects that follow.

• Triage the day-to-day RevOps request queue while maintaining progress on a longer-term roadmap.

• Help the revenue organization extract real value from AI tools, from enablement and training to building new workflows.

What We're Looking For

• 6+ years in revenue operations or sales operations at B2B SaaS companies, including at least 2 years owning the function or a significant part of it, ideally from an early or founding RevOps hire stage.

• Deep Salesforce expertise, including Flows, data model changes, integrations, and full admin seat ownership, not just ticket-based requests.

• Hands-on experience with a full GTM stack: sales engagement (Salesloft, Outreach, or similar), scheduling and routing (ChiliPiper or similar), data providers (ZoomInfo, Apollo, or similar), and marketing automation (HubSpot, Marketo, or similar).

• Demonstrated ability to run pipeline and forecast cadences and produce board-level reporting for a CRO or CEO.

• Experience designing lead routing and cross-team rules of engagement across multiple GTM functions, with comfort navigating the complexity that comes with it.

• Ability to pull and shape data independently using SQL or a BI tool such as Mode, Looker, or Equals.

• Clear communicator at every level, from individual reps to the executive team, with the confidence to push back and explain why.

• Collaborate with attorneys and support staff while maintaining strong client relationships.

title: Vice President of State and Local Campaigns
description:
The Proportional Representation Hub

American democracy is at a breaking point. Across the country, voters increasingly find themselves throwing up their hands and turning away from a failing political system. Hyper-partisanship has become entrenched. Fewer than one in ten House races is competitive, and 97% of incumbents cruise to reelection: for most voters, the outcome was settled before a single ballot was cast. Little wonder that politicians feel little pressure to deliver legislative results. Public trust in democratic institutions continues to erode as more and more voters tune out.

But the problem isn’t the politicians. It’s the rules. U.S. elections are distorted by single-winner, winner-take-all districts. A party can win 45% of the vote in districts across a state yet it wins no power. The Supreme Court’s evisceration of the Voting Rights Act has made things much worse: voters in communities of color are being carved up and packed into districts engineered to drown out their voices, and the court has triggered a redistricting death spiral. The need for structural reform has never been more urgent.

There is a fix, and most of the world already uses it: proportional representation. The idea is simple--districts elect several members, and a party that wins a third of the votes wins about a third of the seats. It breaks the two-party monopoly, makes every district competitive, eliminates partisan gerrymandering, and reduces polarization.

The Proportional Representation Hub has launched to help build the next chapter of American democracy. We have raised more than $70 million to lead a campaign to advance proportional representation at the local, state, and federal levels and build a government that delivers again. Proportional representation is the best path to create a democracy that better reflects the diversity of the American people, and the best path to end the redistricting wars.

This work is ambitious: forging unlikely coalitions, winning new legislation and ballot measures, changing public narratives, and developing innovative political strategies. Above all, it demands a cross-partisan movement big enough to persuade the huge majority of Americans who say the political system no longer works for them that our democracy can work far better than it does today.

We are building a team of exceptional leaders working together to reshape the architecture of American democracy itself.

Position Summary

The Vice President of State and Local Campaigns will design, build, and win the campaigns that will make proportional representation a political reality across the United States, one of the most important democracy reform efforts of the next decade.

The Vice President of State and Local Campaigns will lead efforts to advance proportional representation through ballot measures and legislative campaigns at the state, city, and county level. This executive will develop and oversee a national portfolio of state and local campaigns, identifying opportunities for breakthrough victories while building long-term political power for the movement. They will work closely with local organizers, advocacy organizations, elected officials, coalition partners, philanthropic investors, and policy experts to build winning campaigns that can serve as models for replication nationwide.

The successful candidate will bring extensive experience winning state-level legislative and ballot campaigns, advancing policy reforms through complex political environments, and ideally leading sophisticated local campaigns.

The Vice President of State and Local Campaigns will serve as a member of the organization’s Senior Leadership Team.

This is a role for a senior strategist, movement builder, and campaign leader who understands how to translate ambitious ideas into real-world political victories.

What You’ll Lead

Win State and Local Victories

• Design and execute ambitious state and local campaign strategies that advance proportional repres

title: Principal, Back-Office AI Transformation

Living our values everyday results in our team-first culture and enables us to innovate, grow, and thrive while enjoying the journey together. We celebrate diversity and foster an inclusive environment, empowering our employees to be their authentic selves. 

The Principal, Back-Office AI Transformation owns hands-on delivery of Five9’s internal back-office AI automation agenda. This individual-contributor role belongs to someone who does the work directly: they scope a use case, build or stand up the automation, and prove out the value, rather than direct others to do it. As pilots convert into a scaled program, we expect this role to grow into building out the team behind it: forward-deployed engineers and process professionals, human and agentic.

The mandate has three connected parts:

• Run the diagnostic as an ongoing discipline. Baseline and reassess opportunities continually, drawing on employee input, process observation, and benchmarking, to keep the portfolio pointed at real value outcomes.

• Deliver the pilot: a bounded, evidence-generating pilot in a priority workflow, through to measured results.

• Build the blueprint and roadmap so Five9 can mobilize the next pilot and scale what works.

Throughout, you’re held to the same discipline the diagnostic itself demands: you separate real business impact (cost, capacity, quality, speed) from time-savings claims that don’t hold up.

You partner with Business Technology on tooling, with the leaders of Finance, HR, Legal, IT, and other back-office functions whose work is under review, and with any outside delivery partners brought in for a specific phase. The goal is durable internal capability, not outside dependency.

The right person has built or shipped an automation, workflow, or AI-native tool inside a real back-office function, and is as comfortable running the underlying analysis as pairing with an engineer on the build. They partner with finance, HR, legal, and technology organizations and understand how those teams operate day to day, beyond how they appear in an org chart.

AI Readiness Diagnostic

• Assess readiness across what determines whether an opportunity is fundable: process and workflow, data, technology and integration, talent and operating model, and governance, beyond where the potential value looks biggest.

• Surface change readiness alongside the opportunity itself, treating early listening and engagement as the first step in adoption rather than an afterthought.

• Define the ontology and context graph for each function in scope: the semantic layer, metric definitions, and function-specific intelligence layer that make the diagnostic and every pilot after it usable. Work with the business to define the ontology and with Business Technology to set the right graph architecture across the organization.

Pilot Delivery

• Own end-to-end delivery of a bounded pilot in a priority back-office workflow, from process discovery and future-state design through a small, controlled user trial with real tasks and human oversight.

• Distinguish demonstrated pilot results from projected benefits at scale, and report what was tested, who used it, and where the evidence has real limits.

• Translate pilot learning into the next blueprint by defining the future workflow, human-AI handoffs, build tasks, and approvals needed to mobilize the following pilot.

Prioritization & Business Case

• Turn diagnostic findings into a ranked, fundable portfolio, evaluated against agreed criteria for value, readiness, difficulty, risk, and time

•
Strong math foundation, comfortable with Pre-Algebra or above; Math, STEM-related, or Education majors preferred

• Available during the class windows above; available on at least one weekend day

title: Product Owner, Card Programs
description:
Flex is building the AI-native private bank for super premium, closely held business owners.
We are re-architecting the entire financial system for entrepreneurs. From the first dollar a business earns to how that value compounds, moves, and is ultimately spent in real life. Banking, credit, payments, personal finance, financial operations, all rebuilt from the ground up as a single intelligent system.
Since launching publicly in September 2023, we have scaled from zero to nine-figure annualized revenue with a clear path to profitability by late 2026. We move fast, ship relentlessly, and operate with extreme ownership.
Our customers are affluent business owners with $3M to $200M in revenue. The backbone of the economy and one of the most underserved segments in finance. We are replacing the outdated banks and fragmented tools they are stuck with. The opportunity is a roughly $1T+ revenue market hiding in plain sight. We are building toward $100B+ in enterprise value by delivering a product that is fundamentally better, not incrementally improved.
Flex has raised $100M+ in equity and $300M+ in debt.
What we hold ourselves to: mission-critical problems, high bar low ego, speed over comfort, enduring impact.
Locations: San Francisco, New York, Miami, remote. Open to candidates in Canada, Mexico, the United States, Brazil, and Colombia.
The Role
You will own Flex 's card programs end to end. We are running a meaningful annualized credit program today. We are launching multiple new card products in the next two quarters across credit, stablecoin, and rewards. Your job is to scale this from one major program to five-plus and take total volume across the portfolio up by more than an order of magnitude.
This is not a card fulfillment seat. This is the owner of every layer of our card stack: ledger, processing, servicing, fulfillment, BIN sponsor relationships, network relationships, and the operational discipline that lets us run multiple programs concurrently without seams.
We want someone who has personally spun up a card program from scratch, not as a secondary contributor. Someone who can sit in a meeting with a major processor or card network, hear a vendor explanation, and call out exactly where the story is bullshit. Someone who knows what FTS, ARI, DPS, BINs, and the rest of the alphabet actually mean and where vendors hide behind acronyms.
You will partner closely with your engineering counterpart and be on a small team initially. Your first job after landing is to tell us who you need to hire next. This is a business unit builder seat.
What you will do
Own every layer of Flex 's card programs: ledger, processing, servicing, fulfillment, BIN sponsor management, network relationships.
Lead processor strategy and the direct network relationship. Hold vendors accountable. Drive the technical and commercial negotiations.
Build the operational infrastructure that supports five concurrent card programs across credit, stablecoin, and rewards.
Architect the path to scale the portfolio by more than 20x. Build the operating model that makes that scale possible without breaking customer experience.
Recruit the next layer of the card programs team as the function grows. You will tell us who we need to hire and when.

title: Senior Engineer
description:
SENIOR SOFTWARE ENGINEER

London | Full-time | Hybrid | Shoreditch/Liverpool Street

CREATE THE FUTURE OF TRAVEL WITH US

Whether it's visiting the people closest to us, starting an exciting adventure, or a career-defining business trip, travel is essential.

Yet we've all experienced the aches and pains of getting to our destination.

More than 4 billion airline passengers rely on technology that hasn't kept up with modern expectations. That's why we're rebuilding the infrastructure that underpins the travel industry - simplifying systems and building tools that will make the future of travel effortless.

We were part of Y Combinator S18's cohort and we're backed by Benchmark, Blossom, Index Ventures, and Kima Ventures - a fantastic set of investors that has helped build some of the world's largest companies.

Our London team is growing, and we're looking for a Senior Engineer to help shape both the product and the team building it.

ENGINEERING AT DUFFEL

We're building tools to simplify travel distribution, search, and booking through one seamless API. The technical challenge? Design a world class API, then integrate it with a vast number of travel providers - each with different systems and requirements - whilst delivering a fantastic developer experience.

We work with Elixir, Phoenix, Kubernetes, and Google Cloud Platform, but we value strong engineering fundamentals over specific tech experience.

As a Senior Engineer, you won't just execute against a spec - you'll help define what gets built and how. You'll take on ambiguous problems, shape technical decisions across teams, and set a bar for quality that others follow.

YOU'LL THRIVE HERE IF:

✅ You've designed and shipped APIs at scale, and have a clear point of view on what makes a great one

✅ You can take a loosely-defined problem and turn it into a clear technical plan, working independently - weighing technical rigour against business impact along the way

✅ You think in systems: you can trace how a decision in one part of the stack ripples into others, and design with those knock-on effects in mind

✅ You want to keep writing production code as a senior engineer, not move away from it - this role is hands-on for the long run, not just at the start

✅ You've mentored engineers or helped them do their best work, and take real satisfaction in others reaching the bar you hold yourself to

✅ You communicate clearly, articulating what you're working on, why, and the reasoning behind your tradeoffs, in a structured way, to a variety of internal and external stakeholders.

✅ You thrive collaboratively - you believe in your methods but stay open to feedback and suggestions, and know when to stand by your approach and when to compromise

Bonus: Experience in travel, flights, hotels, or cars

WHAT YOU'LL GET:

💰 Competitive salary + equity (you'll own part of Duffel)

🏝️ Work from anywhere policy

🏥 Private Healthcare

🛩️ Duffel travel allowance (use what we build)

🍼 Matched Family leave

🧘‍♂️ Sabbatical programme (3 months full pay)

🪩 Office in Shoreditch + regular team socials

WHY NOW MATTERS

You'll work on the core API powering millions of travel bookings, with real influence over its direction. Early-stage role = outsized impact on how we build and scale, and a seat at the table for the technical decisions that will define the next phase.

title: Senior/Staff Analytics Engineer
description:
At Render, we’re building the modern cloud platform for developers creating AI-native, full-stack, multi-service applications. Our mission is to eliminate the tradeoff between the power of hyperscalers and the simplicity of developer-friendly platforms-so teams can ship fast, scale reliably, and focus on their product, not infrastructure.

Unlike complex hyperscalers or ephemeral edge/serverless solutions, Render offers a developer-first experience with persistent compute, dynamic autoscaling, built-in orchestration, and observability, allowing teams to launch, scale, and manage real-world applications without writing infrastructure code or managing servers. Whether you're building LLM-powered applications, scalable SaaS products, or async processing pipelines, Render empowers teams to move fast and scale confidently from MVP to millions of users.

Our platform is trusted by over 7 million developers worldwide and continues to grow rapidly. In February 2026, we raised an additional $100M in Series C financing, bringing our total funding to $260M, to accelerate our vision of making cloud infrastructure both powerful and intuitive-designed for the speed of modern AI development.

We’re a diverse and talented team that values craft, velocity, and user experience. If you’re excited to help shape the future of the intelligent cloud and empower developers everywhere, we’d love to hear from you.

APPLYING TO RENDER

We're seeking candidates who possess high integrity, humility, and an insatiable drive to learn. Through reasoned discussions and continuous feedback, we strive to improve both individually and collectively. We foster an environment of mutual trust and respect, empowering effective debate to achieve the best outcomes for our customers and team.

We especially encourage members of underrepresented groups in the tech community to apply and understand that not all successful candidates will meet each requirement listed.

Our interview process is unique to each role, and we value the candidate experience just as much as our customer experience. We hope your conversations with us reflect a thoughtful process that is illuminative, enjoyable, and respectful of your time.

ABOUT THE ROLE

We're looking for a Staff Analytics Engineer to join our growing Data team and lead the evolution of our Analytics Engineering platform. As Render scales, you'll build the foundations that turn raw data into trusted, reusable models for analytics, executive reporting, and AI-assisted decision-making.

In this role, you'll partner closely with analysts, scientists, data engineers, and teams across Product, Engineering, Growth, Go-to-Market, Finance, and other business functions. Analysts and scientists will bring domain expertise and own business logic within their areas; you'll own the technical architecture, modeling standards, and engineering practices that help that work scale reliably.

As a Staff-level individual contributor, you'll set the technical direction for Analytics Engineering at Render-strengthening data quality, improving the developer experience, and building semantic and context layers that make data easier to discover and use. You'll help teams move faster with consistent metrics and maintainable models they can trust.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

- Own our Analytics Engineering architecture. Guide the long-term evolution of Render’s Analytics Engineering platform, strengthening foundational models so our data remains trusted, scalable, and ready for AI-assisted analytics.

- Build trusted, reusable data models. Design, build, and maintain governed dbt models that serve as authoritative sources for business-critical metrics across Product, Engineering, Growth, Go-to-Market, Finance, and other teams.

- Establish engineering standards. Define and improve practices for data modeling, testing, documentation, version control, CI/CD, and code review. Review high-impact dbt changes and reduce technical debt across the analytics codebase.

- Ena

title: Founder Associate at Retail Insights
Stage M2 : Recherche en optique non linéaire appliquée à la caractérisation de dispositifs électroniques neuromorphiques - 6 mois
description:
Mines Saint-Etienne est une Ecole de l’Institut Mines-Télécom (IMT), 1er groupe public d’écoles d’ingénieurs et de management en France. L’IMT est un EPSCP (grand établissement) sous la tutelle du Ministère de l’Économie, des Finances et de la Souveraineté Industrielle et Numérique.
L’École Nationale Supérieure des Mines de Saint-Étienne (Mines Saint-Etienne) est chargée de missions de formation, de recherche et d’innovation, de transfert vers l’industrie et de culture scientifique, technique et industrielle.
Mines Saint-Etienne représente: 2 400 élèves-ingénieurs et chercheurs en formation, 480 personnels (150 Chercheurs et Enseignants-chercheurs), un budget consolidé de 46 M€, 3 campus dédiés à l’industrie à Saint-Etienne et Lyon (région AURA), à la microélectronique et aux objets connectés à Gardanne (Métropole Aix-Marseille Provence, région SUD) et à l’ingénierie pour la santé à Saint-Etienne ; 6 unités de recherche ; 5 centres de formation et de recherche ; un centre de culture scientifique technique et industrielle leader en France « La Rotonde » (> 50 000 visiteurs / an).

Contexte scientifique et objectifs du stage :
Des dispositifs d’électronique organique ultra-flexibles, conformables et implantables incorporant une intelligence artificielle promettent de révolutionner la surveillance et le traitement en temps réel de maladies chroniques [1]. De tels systèmes pourraient être basés sur des transistors organiques électrochimiques (OECTs), exploitant des conducteurs polymères mixtes ion-électron (PMIECs) comme couches actives. En effet, les PMIECs sont apparus comme une excellente plateforme matérielle pour interfacer la biologie avec l’électronique conventionnelle ; identifié comme le domaine de la « bioélectronique organique ou plastique ». L’OECT est considéré comme l’éléments clé pour réaliser une telle interface [2]. Son efficacité est évaluée suivant des figures de mérite (FoMs) telles que i) la transconductance (gm), et/ou ii) les temps de commutation (ionique vs. électronique) dans le dispositif. Au-delà des applications de transduction, à court terme, l’OECT est aussi intéressant pour créer des applications émergentes en matière de circuits neuromorphiques bioélectroniques [3].
La réalisation de tels circuits est freinée par un manque de compréhension et d’optimisation des processus de conduction mixte dans ces matériaux polymériques ; notamment une asymétrie des temps de commutation des transistors lors des séquences de dopage (i.e « ON ») vs dédopage (i.e « OFF ») dans le canal de l’OECT. Des outils de caractérisation in-situ & operando permettant de quantifier et cartographier les paramètres de transduction électronique et électrochimique dans le canal de l’OECT se révèlent être indispensables pour comprendre les limitations actuelles en performances des PMIECs et/ou pour construire des PMIECs optimums dans de tels circuits neuromorphiques.

Dans ce contexte scientifique, le.la stagiaire développera une nouvelle mesure de spectroscopie et instrumentation d’optique non linéaire, appelée microscopie par génération de second harmonique résolue en temps, afin d’enregistrer le mouvement spatio-temporel des espèces chargées, ion et électrons (ou trous), et ainsi donc cartographier les mobilités électroniques in-situ & operando le canal de l’OECT.
La.le stagiaire fabriquera ces dispositifs OECTs en salle blanche de microélectronique, et bénéficiera d’un accompagnement technique pour leur réalisation. Il.elle enregistrera et analysera les FoMs clés grâce à l'expérimentation d’optique non linéaire développée et aux caractérisations électriques et électrochimiques afin d’établir, de manière plus globale, des règles d’ingénierie dans ces PMIECs qui serviront de socle de connaissances incontournables à l’avenir, pour mettre en œuvre et appliquer des circuits neuromorphiques à base d'OECTs, comme première brique d’une intelligence artificielle d’électronique organique.

DigitalOrganizing Manager (Remote)
THE ROLE:
NextGen America is currently seeking a creative, self-starting Distributed Organizing Manager to join our Distributed Organizing team. The distributed organizing team will work to build and grow strong digital communities to help engage with young voters, expand ballot access, and elect progressives up and down the ballot. We are looking for organizers to spread the #YouthVote across digital networks, recruit folks online into strong volunteer networks, and lead volunteer teams in direct voter contact using peer-to-peer (P2P) texting in Scale to Win Text and other distributed tools.
The ideal candidate has a passion for politics and a belief that young people will make the difference in America’s future. We are an equal opportunity employer, and we encourage people of diverse backgrounds and experiences to apply. We value and are committed to diversity, equity, and inclusion as an organization--in theory and in practice--and our culture reflects that value and commitment. We are committed to furthering issues like climate change, health care, and economic and racial justice from a progressive perspective, we seek to engage the public in these areas as well as others. We also recognize the urgency of confronting institutional racism and inequity within our political system and strive to make positive changes within our system as a result.
This role will report to the Distributed Organizing Director.
This is a fully remote position with no location requirement. We encourage candidates from all locations within the United States to apply.
FLSA Classification: Exempt
Remote Position: Yes
Union Position: No
Travel Requirements: Less than 10%
End Date: 11/6/26
WHAT YOU’LL ACHIEVE:

• Execute a values-driven and data-informed distributed organizing program with a team that will recruit, train, and organize remote volunteers to hit voter contact and mobilization goals in key 2026races and states.

• Run regular P2P campaigns including data requests, script and campaign drafting, QA process, campaign launch, and debrief and clean up.

• Draft and edit training guides, memos, templates, and toolkits to support volunteers’ direct voter contact over email, phone, text, Slack, and other platforms.

• Lead trainings or workshops and coach our volunteers before, during, or after their shifts

• Pull regular data metrics and write regular progress qualitative and quantitative reports on the impact of direct voter contact.

• Recruit, train, and engage a team of volunteer leaders.

• Be a digital community manager and administrator.

• Perform other duties as assigned

ABOUT YOU:

• Familiarity administering and managing peer-to-peer texting campaigns on platforms such as Scale to Win Text, Hustle, ThruText (formerly Relay), Spoke, and/or others.

• Experience in either field or digital positions on political campaigns, training volunteers, OR have managed and grown active online communities.

• Exceptional writing, copyediting, and proofreading skills.

• The candidate must have excellent organizational skills, and demonstrate a clear ability to adapt rapidly to evolving priorities and deadlines.

• They must have a strong work ethic and demonstrate consistent attention to detail.

• Able to collaborate effectively in a fast-paced team setting.

• Demonstrate strong team working skills by fostering a supportive and motivating atmosphere.

BONUS POINTS FOR:

• Experience growing and managing digital volunteer teams.

• Experience and comfortability with leading digital trainings and/or events

• Proficiency with advocacy CRM tools such as NGP VAN, Mobilize, and Action Network Experience working with multiple tools within the Google Workspace.

SALARY INFORMATION:
The starting salary range for this position is $72,000 - $85,000. The final base salary will be determined by various factors, including individual qualifications and internal parity, which will be objectively assessed during the interview

ChowNow is one of the leading players in off-premise restaurant technology. As takeout becomes a vital revenue stream for independent restaurants, our platform helps owners focus on what they do best-serving great food-by offering solutions across the entire digital dining experience. From building branded websites and mobile apps, to powering online orders, managing menus, consolidating delivery, and running targeted marketing, we give restaurants the tools to grow on their own terms.

title: Senior Lifecycle Marketing Manager
description:
ABOUT DOCKER

Docker has been one of the most loved brands in developer tooling, trusted by more than 20 million monthly users and over 20 billion container image pulls. From solo founders to the world's largest companies, developers rely on Docker to build, share, and run their applications across our suite of products including Docker Desktop, Docker Hub, and Docker Scout.

We are a globally distributed, remote-first team building the tools that define how software gets built and delivered. As AI agents redefine software development, Docker is at the center of that shift, providing the sandboxed environments, verified images, and secure infrastructure that make autonomous workflows trustworthy by default.

_______________________________________________________________________

Docker's Product-Led Growth (PLG) team owns turning product usage into revenue across the full Platform: the Container business (Docker Desktop, Docker Hub, Docker Build Cloud, Docker Scout) and the AI business (Sandboxes, AI Governance, Model Runner, MCP Toolkit, MCP Catalog). Lifecycle marketing is one of the fastest-scaling parts of that team: it already owns user and admin nurtures, renewal automation, and first-touch outreach for PQLs and inbound leads, running against a marketable base in the tens of millions.

As Senior Lifecycle Marketer, you'll report directly to the VP of PLG and partner closely with our existing lifecycle marketing lead. You'll take ownership of assigned products, audiences, and lifecycle stages, with real input into shaping the approach for what you own, not just shipping someone else's plan, and you'll help turn a fast-growing list of priorities into a structured, scalable lifecycle engine.

WHAT MAKES SOMEONE SUCCESSFUL IN THIS ROLE

- Lifecycle Fluency: You think in full user journeys, not campaigns. You've done lifecycle marketing specifically, not just growth or demand gen, and you know how nurture, activation, retention, and renewal connect across a product's full lifecycle.

- Builder's Mindset: You'd rather own a program end to end, strategy, build, QA, and send, than hand pieces of it off. You bring structure to ambiguity: turning a fast-growing list of priorities into themes, a build queue, and a sequenced roadmap.

- Audience & Signal Validation: You know how to validate an audience and its underlying signal before it ships: spot-checking record-level data, sanity-checking targeting logic, and catching a bad segment before it reaches users. You don't need to write SQL yourself, but you can work directly with data teams to confirm a list is right.

- Cross-Functional Operator: You operate well across marketing, sales (BDR and renewals), data, and design/agency partners, and you know how to keep programs moving even when you don't own every dependency.

- Marketing Automation Execution: You've personally built campaigns in Marketo or an equivalent platform, not just briefed them: audience builds, suppressions and contact governance, pre-send QA and live proofs, and launch monitoring, including troubleshooting a broken data sync in the moment.

- Technical Translation: You can take a technical product or a raw usage signal, a feature adoption event, a usage threshold, a new capability, and turn it into messaging that reads credible to a developer or admin, not generic marketing copy.

RESPONSIBILITIES

- Build the Lifecycle Engine: Own and build lifecycle campaigns (email and in-product messaging) across Docker's Container and AI Platform products, including Sandboxes and AI Governance, for both end users and admins.

- Scale Programmatic Sends: Design and run large-scale programmatic sends, such as recurring account health checks, to a base in the tens of millions, working within the team's marketing automation stack (currently Marketo and Mailgun; expect a platform transition in the next 6-12 months).

title: VP of Engineering
description:
CancerNavigator is a healthcare startup dedicated to supporting cancer patients in their hour of need.
Our Mission & Our Work, in Brief
Cancer is the number one cause of death for commercially insured Americans and the top cost driver for health plans. And, cancer patients are struggling.
CancerNavigator is a white-glove, end-to-end, cancer support service for patients and their families. We work with health plans across the country to provide 1-1 support to members facing a cancer diagnosis. Our support is delivered through dedicated Oncology Certified Nurses, who help members get to fantastic experts for their care and help them through the thousands of other problems that arise across the cancer journey.
Join us to serve cancer patients in their hour of need.
The “VP of Engineering” Role
Role and Team:
As VP of Engineering, you’ll join CancerNavigator at a pivotal stage of growth and have the opportunity to shape what our engineering function becomes. Reporting directly to the CEO, you’ll initially operate as a highly hands-on technical leader-setting the technical strategy, defining the roadmap, and building alongside the team. Over time, you’ll take on leadership of our existing technical resources and build out the engineering organization needed to support our next stage of scale.
This is not a role where you’ll inherit a mature engineering organization or a predefined roadmap. You’ll work closely with leaders across the business to understand how our service operates today, identify the highest-impact opportunities for technology, and determine what we should build, buy, automate, or redesign.
Daily Work:
This is a highly entrepreneurial, hands-on leadership role. You’ll have significant autonomy to shape both what we build and how engineering operates at CancerNavigator . You will:

• Partner with our CEO and functional leaders to set the technical strategy and roadmap for the business.

• Identify the highest-impact opportunities to use technology and AI to help our team serve more patients at scale.

• Design and build foundational systems, particularly in the early stages of the role.

• Lead the development of tools across patient navigation, communication, research, and healthcare data processing.

• Grow and lead our engineering function, establishing the team, infrastructure, and practices we’ll need for our next stage of growth.

The Requirements

• Engineering leadership experience, ideally in a VP Engineering, Head of Engineering, or similar role within a health tech company.

• Strong experience building technology in healthcare, with a deep understanding of HIPAA and the security, privacy, and data considerations that come with handling sensitive health information.

• A track record of taking complex technical problems from strategy through architecture and hands-on execution.

• Experience building and scaling technology for a tech-enabled service or other operationally complex business.

• Experience with modern data infrastructure and cloud-based systems, with familiarity in Python and SQL.

• Experience applying AI to automate back-end workflows, augment human operations, and build real-world products.

• An entrepreneurial, hands-on approach-you’re comfortable setting the strategy, operating with ambiguity, and rolling up your sleeves to build.

Strongly preferred: Experience working with medical claims, prior authorization, or other complex healthcare data.
Compensation and Benefits

• Competitive salary and stock option package

• Performance-based incentive compensation

• Remote-first work; live where you want within the U.S.

• All-company on-sites 2-3 times per year

• Medical and Dental Insurance (80% employer paid), Vision Insurance (100% employer paid)

• Healthcare and Dependent Care FSA

• Group Life and AD&D Insurance (involuntary with the option to buy-up coverage)

• Unlimited PTO

We’re building a company where what we do matters. The goal couldn’t be cle
